ui.title: My baby
ui.card_wait: Your baby hasn't written yet today… soon 👀
ui.share_sub: As a photo or a message-by-message video. Let your friends see it too 💛
ui.share_text: My baby isn't born yet, but texts me 💛 Anacan
ui.hook: My baby isn't born yet… but texts me.
ui.about: Just for fun: Anacan writes the messages to match your baby's week.

openers: Mum, can I tell you something? 💛
notifications: You won't believe what I want to tell you today! 💛

love: I haven't seen you yet, but I already love you so much 🥰
I may be the size of a {fruit}, but my heart is full of you 💛
how: Great! It's warm and cosy in here 😌
I'm good, mum. I grew a little more today 🌱
So good! I'm listening to your heartbeat 💓
size: Right now I'm about the size of a {fruit} 😄
I'm in week {week} and growing a little every day 🌱
kick_early: I'm already wiggling, but I'm still so tiny you won't feel it 🤭
I'm doing little somersaults in here 🤸 You'll feel them soon!
kick: Did you feel that? That was me 🦶
I danced today, did you feel it? 💃
That kick was me saying hi 👋🦶
hear_early: My ears are still getting ready, but I'll hear you soon 👂
Let me grow a little more, then I'll hear your voice 🥰
hear: I can hear you, mum! Talk to me again 🥰
Your voice is my favourite music 🎶
Sing me a song and I'll listen 🎵
food: Whatever you eat, I get a taste too 😋
Shall we have some fruit today? 🍎
Mmm, that was yummy! A bit more? 😄
sleep: I want to sleep too 😴 Let's rest together
When you lie down, I relax too 😌
Sorry if I dance at night 🙈
dad: Say hi to dad for me! 👋
I love it when dad talks to your bump 🥰
meet: {weeks_left} more weeks and then we meet! 🤗
I want to see you too! Let me grow a bit more 🌱
It won't be long until we meet 💛
meet_soon: Not long now, mum! I'm getting ready too 🤗
Soon I'll be in your arms 💛
name: What will you call me? 😊 Pick a lovely name!
Any name will sound lovely in your voice 💛
hello: Hiii! I was waiting for you 💛
thanks: Thank you for carrying me around 💛
generic: Hmm… I'll ask about that when I'm bigger 😄
I'm still little, but I loved that 😄
